actp_spec.name: AI Context Transfer Protocol (ACTP)
actp_spec.tagline: Don't explain your project again. Just transfer it.
actp_spec.status: CLI v0.1 complete, BENCH-001 + BENCH-002 complete

core_concept.definition: Portable AI context packets that transfer full project understanding between different AI models without re-explaining.
core_concept.analogy: Git for AI memory — versioned, portable, model-agnostic

core_principles: Model-agnostic — works with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any future model
User-owned — no cloud dependency, your data lives where you put it
Semantic, not raw — captures decisions and state, not raw transcripts
Dual-layer encoding — machine-readable fields + human-readable symbols
Delta sync — only meaningful changes propagate

validated_decisions.decision: Open standard free, Compressor SaaS paid
MCP = transport layer, ACTP = payload layer
Format C (ACTP symbolic) is recommended default
Explicit anti-patterns fix model violations — constraint quality determines compliance

symbolic_layer.description: Two-layer encoding inspired by Method of Loci and von Restorff Effect
symbolic_layer.note: High-entropy tokens like 🔴 increase attention weight in transformers (von Restorff Effect)

node_architecture.conflict_resolution: branch-both + vector clocks, P0 tie = human-in-the-loop

cli_status.in_progress: CLI v0.2: capture and rehydrate commands

BENCH-001.finding: Format C produces best code architecture. Format alone cannot guarantee constraint following.

BENCH-002.constraint: Same + explicit anti-pattern list with provider attribution
BENCH-002.finding: Explicit anti-patterns fixed Gemini: 0/4 → 4/4. Gemini internalized ACTP as native protocol.

proof_of_concept.summary: Entire ACTP development process was itself a live ACTP demo. JSON packets carried context between Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini across multiple sessions. CLI built and tested. Two benchmarks complete (9 + 12 = 21 tests across 3 models). Maestro UI v0.2 functional.
proof_of_concept.verdict: Core concept validated. Both benchmarks prove constraint following works. Automation next.
